source: Real customer reviews from the salon's Fresha page and Google Maps listing, copied 26 Nov 2026. Wording is the reviewers' own (emojis dropped); names shortened to first name + initial.

reviews.name: Tayoni T.
reviews.quote: Had my nanoplastia done at XS Hair Salon and absolutely love the results! My hair was very frizzy and uncontrollable. Now my hair is so smooth, soft, shiny and much less frizzy. The team was lovely and professional throughout. Highly recommend XS Hair Salon!

reviews.name: Maninder K.
reviews.quote: I had a really lovely experience at the salon. The staff were very friendly, welcoming and professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Reena C.
reviews.quote: I had a wonderful experience getting my keratin hair straightening done by Jaison. He was very professional, patient, and clearly skilled at what he does. He took the time to understand my hair type and made sure I was comfortable throughout the process. happy with the results—my hair feels smooth, looks healthy, and is much easier to manage now.

reviews.name: Priya D.
reviews.quote: Anushi was lovely, she really did my hair brilliantly. I love it. The Nanoplasty is an awesome treatment really smooths and gives shine to my hair. Thank you will be back.

reviews.name: Ashley M.
reviews.quote: 10/10 keratin straightening and nanoplasty with trim on my 4c hair. The hair stays straight after wash. 3rd time coming here for my hair touch ups. Would definitely recommend. Friendly service and great salon. Thank u

reviews.name: Kezang C.
reviews.quote: Love my grey hair colour. The staff at XS Hair and Beauty Salon were so friendly, and I’m really happy with the result. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Vihangi S.
reviews.quote: Highly recommend XS Hair & Beauty Salon! I had an amazing Nanoplastia treatment my hair is now smooth, silky, frizz-free, and has a gorgeous natural shine. It’s so easy to maintain! The team was incredibly friendly and professional throughout. My husband also got a haircut here and absolutely loved it. We will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Joanne
reviews.quote: Friendly and informative about the process. Love how it turned out

reviews.name: Tangi J.
reviews.quote: Welcoming, friendly and knowledgeable. Head massage was amazing! This will be my go to salon for hair and beauty services. Thank you for your wonderful service this morning.

reviews.name: Rochelle L.
reviews.quote: Nimesha took great care of me and did my Nanoplastia treatment with so much care and attention to detail. She was very gentle, professional, and made sure everything was done perfectly.
